description: Every place EclipseMission has measured for the total solar eclipse of 2 August 2027, in the order of the site's ranking: the places every reader can go to, ranked by lodging price per person, cheapest first, then Mecca, priced but unranked (entry restricted to Muslims). For each: totality duration (our validated oracle), lodging for two adults over four nights, 31 July to 4 August 2027 (mean of the ten cheapest rooms, dated), the Eclipse Premium (that price over the same search a week later), cloud as a range of two reanalyses, heat, public-transport access, the nearest airport and our one-word verdict. Filters narrow the list; they never reorder it.

country.description: Keep one country, by English name or ISO code, whatever the case: Egypt, Gibraltar, Morocco, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Tunisia.

max_price_per_person_eur.description: Keep places whose four-night stay costs at most this per person, in EUR (the price for two, halved).

min_totality_seconds.description: Keep places with at least this much totality, in seconds (the longest on our list is about 381).

open_to_all_visitors.description: true leaves out places whose entry is restricted (Mecca, closed to non-Muslims).

name: list_destinations
title: Where to see the 2027 eclipse, cheapest first
